patterns.note: The hero section employs an asymmetrical layout, featuring a prominent, left-aligned heading and a large, slightly angled product UI screenshot on the right, partially overlapping a vibrant, organic green gradient background.
Primary headings utilize a large, bold sans-serif typeface for impact, contrasted with a smaller, lighter sans-serif for body text, maintaining clear hierarchy and readability.
A high-contrast black and white base palette is consistently energized by a dynamic, organic green gradient used as a background element and a key accent color for calls to action.
The cookie banner slides in from the bottom right on initial scroll, and product UI elements within screenshots feature subtle, engaging animations to demonstrate functionality.
Product screenshots are integrated as large, central visual elements, often with a slight 3D perspective or angle, effectively showcasing the user interface in context across various content blocks.

technique_notes: The hero section combines a prominent, left-aligned text block with a large, slightly angled product UI screenshot, set against a dynamic, organic green gradient background that extends full-width.

Scroll-triggered reveals: Sections and content blocks appear to animate into view with a subtle upward translation and opacity fade as they enter the viewport, likely using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript animation library.

Interactive UI elements: Product screenshots often feature subtle animations (e.g., a cursor moving, elements highlighting) to demonstrate functionality, likely implemented with Lottie animations or embedded video.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif hero heading (~4-5x body text) with standard, lighter body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero section, balanced in content grids and feature blocks

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the dynamic, organic green gradient that serves as a vibrant backdrop and visual anchor, especially in the hero and footer. This, combined with the large, slightly angled product UI screenshots featuring subtle animations, creates a sense of modern energy and tangible product presence that elevates it beyond a typical SaaS marketing page.
